development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); the residual model is fitted on the other two months' matched rows and applied to the held-out month's matched rows

external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of the 2025 months; pass 2 anchors on them

floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual
prior_evidence: (2) a per-airport offset audit on 2025-03-10 (docs/opensky/adsb_pushback_audit.json); (3) a seven-day March 2025 day-grouped test with a simple baseline (not v9): EDDM -38%, LSZH -30%, EHAM -26%, LEBL -22%, EDDF -19%, EGLL -8%, LEMD 0%, LFPG/LIRF/LTFM no coverage, overall -6.7%. No number against v9 existed before this declaration; the leave-one-month-out scores below are computed from scratch by tools/run_adsb_v11.py.

residual_model.applies_to: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment (adsb_matched == 1); every other row keeps the v9 prediction exactly
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: early stopping (200 rounds patience, at most 4000) on the held-out month is NOT used for selection; rounds per held-out month come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration); export: median of the three development round counts
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on matched rows, then floor

selection: For each candidate weight, RMSE of (v9 + weight * residual) on each held-out month versus v9 on the same rows (all departures of the month, matched or not). A candidate is eligible when it is at least 0.5% lower than v9 on EACH of the three months. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio; otherwise select nothing. Per-airport reports are descriptive only.
